title: NFC Fitness Wristbands — Tap Check-In & Cashless Gym
summary: NFC fitness wristbands put gym check-in, locker access, class attendance, and tap-to-pay on one sweat-proof IP68 medical-grade silicone band. Chip options span NTAG213 / 216 through MIFARE DESFire EV3 (AES-128), matched to the installed reader fleet. Mindbody, ABC Fitness Solutions, PerfectGym, Glofox, and Wodify consume the wristband UID via SDK or middleware. MOQ 500; lead time 12-15 business days.

brief.label: Substrate — medical-grade silicone for sweat + shower wear
items: Platinum-cured medical-grade silicone (LSR / HCR), Shore A 50-60 hardness, smooth matte finish; IP68 sweat / shower / chlorine / sunscreen tolerance.
Hypoallergenic, latex-free, BPA-free, phthalate-free; clears FDA 21 CFR 177.2600 + EU REACH SVHC + RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; ISO 10993-5 + 10993-10 biocompatibility evaluation framework reference.
Antimicrobial-additive variant (silver-ion or quat-ammonium) for shared / institutional issue programmes (corporate wellness, hotel fitness, university rec centre).

brief.label: Air interface and chip pairing
items: 13.56 MHz HF, ISO/IEC 14443-A — NTAG213 (144 B, default UID-based check-in), NTAG216 (888 B for on-chip member-data + Apple/Google Wallet pairing URL), MIFARE Classic 1K (legacy gym-system compatibility — CRYPTO-1 caveat), MIFARE Plus EV2 (pin-compatible AES upgrade), MIFARE DESFire EV2 / EV3 (AES-128 + per-card key diversification per NXP AN10922 + EV3 SDM for cashless and multi-site chains).
Chip choice matches the installed reader fleet at the gym; switching wristband supplier is invisible to the gym-management platform.

brief.label: Closures for daily fitness wear
items: Adjustable watch-style pin buckle (reusable, most popular) — survives daily on / off cycles; member can remove for shower, sleep, machine-wash if desired.
Snap-button closure — alternative reusable; more secure on smaller wrists.
Always-on continuous wear is the typical pattern; the IP68 substrate supports 24/7 wear without irritation under FDA / ISO 10993 prolonged-skin-contact framework.

items: Mindbody — boutique studio (yoga / spin / HIIT / barre / Pilates) booking, capacity, class attendance.

PerfectGym — multi-site chain management, member-tier access control.

Club Automation, ClubReady, Jonas, Mariana Tek — sector-specific gym platforms.
MatrixOne, Daxko Operations, Currents — large multi-site management.
All consume the wristband UID via SDK or middleware; pre-encoded UID manifest CSV ships before bulk dispatch.

brief.label: Apple Wallet Passes / Google Wallet mirroring
items: NFC wristband + Apple Wallet Pass / Google Wallet pass = digital + physical member credential mirrored.
Members tap the band at terminals OR present the wallet pass on Apple Watch / Android Watch — both resolve to the same gym-platform member record.
Apple PassKit + Google Wallet API integration is platform-side; the wristband UID matching the wallet pass UID is the structural link.

brief.label: Class-door attendance and capacity enforcement
items: Studio-door tap reader records every class entry; class roster auto-populates with attendance timestamps.
Capacity enforcement: when class is at capacity, the door reader rejects late taps and routes the member to the waitlist auto-release queue.
No-show prevention: members who book and don't tap-in within the cancellation window flag in the platform for credit / fee / coaching workflow.

brief.label: Locker access integration
items: Electronic locker systems (Foxtrot, Best Lockers, Ojmar, Digilock) accept the wristband UID for tap-to-lock + tap-to-unlock.
Locker assignment auto-records to the member record at first tap; locker hold-time enforcement (4 hr typical for staffed clubs, 24 hr for member-storage premium tier) automated by the system.
Lost-locker-key replacement labour drops to near zero on properly-maintained electronic-lock fleets.

brief.label: Cashless juice bar / pro shop / personal training
items: MIFARE DESFire EV3 with on-chip stored value or NTAG216 with cloud-linked member-folio; tap-to-pay at juice bar, pro shop, personal-training desk.
Per-visit secondary-spend uplift consistently reported in IHRSA / ABC Fitness / Mindbody benchmarks when payment is a wristband tap vs wallet reach.
End-of-month folio reconciliation to credit card on file; PCI-DSS scoping — closed-loop folio out of scope for the wristband, top-up step on credit card stays in scope on the platform side.

brief.label: Boutique studio and hotel fitness deployment
items: Boutique studio: same band carries member identity across multiple participating locations in a chain (e.g. SoulCycle, Equinox, Barry's Bootcamp, Rumble) — single tap, multi-location.
Hotel fitness centres: guest-room wristband (vinyl / silicone) carries gym-only access permission for room-rate guests; resort tier members get full-amenity access.
Corporate wellness: gym-access + cafeteria payment + building-entry credential consolidated on a single band.

brief.label: Branding and personalisation
items: Pantone-matched silicone moulding, debossed / colour-filled-deboss / silkscreen logo, sequential numbering, member-tier visual flagging.
Limited-edition launches (annual challenge bands, transformation programmes, brand-collaboration drops) on a separate per-batch SKU at the same MOQ.
Glow-in-the-dark and reflective silicone variants for night-cycling / outdoor-fitness programmes.

brief.label: Lifecycle and replacement
items: Annual replacement cadence is the typical maintenance pattern; chip is rated 100,000+ EEPROM write cycles per NXP data sheets — lifecycle bound is band wear (logo fade, snap fatigue), not chip failure.
Replacement bands at lower per-unit cost than initial issuance — artwork and chip-encoding templates already on file; new chip UID re-pairs to the same member record at re-issue.

brief.label: Procurement and operations
items: MOQ 500 silicone with custom Pantone colour + debossed logo; lead time 12-15 business days.
Stock colours (black / blue / red / green) with NTAG213 ship on shorter lead time at lower MOQ.
Bulk annual supply agreements with quarterly delivery schedules and locked pricing for chain operators (5,000-50,000 bands / year).

sections.title: Why a fitness-specific wristband — daily wear arithmetic
bullets: Forgotten cards / forgotten apps create front-desk queues; the wristband stays on the wrist between visits and at night, the credential is always there.
Phone unlock mid-workout is impractical; wristband tap completes at sub-second ISO/IEC 14443-4 reader timing without screen interaction.
Hygiene perception — tapping a wristband against a wall reader is contactless; setting a phone on a sweat-covered surface or handing a card to staff is not.

sections.title: From plastic card to wristband + wallet-pass mirroring

items.label: 1990s
items.text: Plastic gym membership cards dominate; manual front-desk check-in, paper class-attendance, cash payment at juice bar / pro shop.

items.label: 2000s
items.text: Magnetic-stripe and bar-coded cards standardise; gym-management platforms (PerfectGym predecessor, ABC Financial, ClubReady) emerge with card-UID member-record mapping.
MIFARE Classic 1K commoditises 13.56 MHz HF NFC; first-generation NFC wristbands enter boutique studio + hotel fitness segments. Mindbody adds card / wristband UID consumption to platform.
Apple Pay launches on iPhone 6; consumer-scale NFC tap normalises. Apple Wallet PassKit eventually adds gym-pass support; Google Wallet API follows.

MIFARE DESFire EV3 + AES-128 + AN10922 per-card key diversification ships; multi-site chain operators upgrade from Classic to DESFire for cryptographic anti-clone + tap-to-pay folio. Apple Wallet / Google Wallet pass mirroring matures as a parallel modality.

Boutique studio chains (SoulCycle, Equinox, Barry's, Rumble) standardise on NFC wristband + wallet-pass mirroring. Cashless juice bar / pro shop / personal training adoption accelerates. Wodify / Glofox / Mariana Tek add wristband-UID workflow for CrossFit and boutique segments.

items.label: 2026 Today
items.text: Cross-buyer reference experience on gym-chain-multi-site, boutique-fitness-club, hotel-fitness-amenity, university-rec-centre, and corporate-wellness programmes shows converge on platinum-cured medical-grade silicone (or antimicrobial-additive variant for institutional issue) + NTAG216 / DESFire EV3 + adjustable watch-style closure + Mindbody / ABC Fitness / PerfectGym / Glofox / Wodify platform integration + Apple Wallet / Google Wallet pass mirroring as the operator-side template.

faq.question: Can the wristband integrate with our gym-management software?
faq.answer: Yes — every dominant gym / fitness platform consumes the NFC chip's UID via SDK or middleware. Mindbody, ABC Fitness Solutions, PerfectGym, Glofox, Wodify, Club Automation, ClubReady, Jonas, MatrixOne, Daxko all support NFC reader integration natively or via API. Proud Tek provides UID lists (CSV manifest) with each order so IT can pre-load member-wristband associations before distribution. Switching wristband supplier is invisible to the platform layer — the chip silicon stays the same, only the form factor changes.

faq.question: How long do NFC fitness wristbands last with daily gym use?
faq.answer: The chip is rated 100,000+ EEPROM write cycles per NXP data sheets — effectively unlimited for read-only check-in use. Silicone band lifecycle is 1-2 years under daily gym wear; logo fade / snap fatigue typically prompts replacement before chip failure. Annual replacement is the standard maintenance cadence; replacement bands at lower per-unit cost than initial issuance — artwork and encoding templates already on file.

faq.question: What is the MOQ and lead time?
faq.answer: Custom Pantone colour + debossed logo: MOQ 500, lead time 12-15 business days. Stock colours (black / blue / red / green) with NTAG213 chip: shorter lead time, lower MOQ. Bulk annual supply agreements with quarterly delivery schedules and locked pricing available for chain operators ordering 5,000-50,000 bands per year. Sample run before bulk commit at no extra charge.

faq.question: Why MIFARE DESFire EV2 / EV3 rather than MIFARE Classic 1K?
faq.answer: MIFARE Classic uses CRYPTO-1 with documented academic attacks (Nohl & Plötz 2008, Garcia 2009, Courtois 2014) — no longer recommended for new payment or high-value access deployments. MIFARE DESFire EV2 / EV3 runs AES-128 mutual authentication with per-card key diversification (NXP AN10922) and is the current recommendation for multi-site chains and tap-to-pay deployments. MIFARE Plus EV2 SL3 is the pin-compatible AES upgrade path for operators with an installed Classic reader base.

faq.question: Does this work alongside Apple Wallet / Google Wallet passes?
faq.answer: Yes — wristband + wallet-pass mirroring is the standard modern pattern. Both the physical wristband and the digital wallet pass resolve to the same gym-platform member record. Members who prefer phone / Watch tap on alternate days use the wallet pass; members who want hands-free workout tap use the wristband. Apple PassKit + Google Wallet API integration is platform-side; the structural link is the wristband UID matching the wallet pass UID.

faq.question: Is silicone the right material for everyone on my member base?
faq.answer: Silicone is hypoallergenic and suits the vast majority of members — clears FDA 21 CFR 177.2600, EU REACH SVHC, RoHS, and the ISO 10993-5 / 10993-10 biocompatibility evaluation framework reference. For members with confirmed silicone sensitivity, Proud Tek stocks fabric and woven-nylon wristbands as alternatives — material-mix orders (silicone majority + small fabric SKU for sensitive members) are supported on the same PO.
